data.title: 远坂凛 · 都市追逐
data.description: 【远坂凛 · 都市追逐】深夜被阴影笼罩的冬木市街道上，凛在屋顶与巷弄间轻盈跃动，指尖已然夹紧了三枚蓄满魔力的纯净红宝石。她眼眸凌厉地紧盯着前方的暗影——「敢在我的领地里随意伤害无辜之人……看来有必要让你见识一下远坂家正统魔术的威力了！」
data.action: 跃过冬木屋顶间隙，一手夹紧三枚红宝石，另一手展开保持平衡，准备追击
data.lighting: deep night shadows and cold moonlight
data.camera: full-body action shot, horizontal framing, three gems and landing ledge visible
data.promptProse: Rin leaps the narrow gap between Fuyuki rooftops at midnight, three red gems held between one hand's fingers while her other arm balances the airborne pose. Her eyes follow the destination ledge, long combat sleeves and glowing circuits tracing the motion. The wide horizontal full-body view includes both roof edges. Cold moonlight defines their raised outlines; nearby rubies cast small red reflections on her fingers against the deep roof shadows.
